Hackers Claim FBI Data Breach, Stole Employee Information

The hacker group ShinyHunters has claimed to have breached the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and stolen data on a large number of current and former employees. The group stated they breached the FBI and stole employee data. The FBI did not respond to requests for comment.
